title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows every origin
description: The policy allowed a stylesheet from any origin. CSS can select on attribute values, so a hostile stylesheet can turn typed text into URL fragments and read them back out, and it can also mask controls the user believes they are clicking. The finding is the unbounded style origin list.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: CSS-driven data exfiltration and interface tampering; MEDIUM severity.
